text:
Maya: quick async check-in for Q3 OKR milestones — pls reply with one-line: shipped / slipped / owner / blocking deps. I'm compiling for Thurs sync. @Jordan @Leah @Owen @Sam
Jordan: shipped — runtime v3 autoscale patch (PR #432). Owner: Jordan. No regressions in canary, moving to prod tomorrow. Dep: none. :tada:
Leah: slipped — Dedicated canary rollout. Owner: Leah. Reason: hit GPU quota in us-west1 during smoke tests. ETA: +1 sprint. Blocking dep: finance quota approval + infra AZ provisioning.
Owen: SRE note — FIN ticket FIN-129 opened for quota, I CC'd infra-ops. I can run a temporary capacity reassign to unblock test runs today if you want. ping me with desired pool size.
Sam: code review pings: need reviews on embed-api PRs that block product validation (PRs #451, #458). Owners: Sam and Priya. If reviewers can do a quick pass today we avoid another sprint slip.
Maya: good, thx. Jordan — confirm prod deploy ETA?
Jordan: prod deploy scheduled 09:30 PT tomorrow, rollout in 3 waves. I'll post the deploy note in #eng-releases and add rollback steps.
Leah: leaning on Owen for temporary pool, will follow up with exact instance counts. Also adding a canary guardrail to abort if p50 latency > 120ms.
Owen: ok will allocate +8 GPUs to the test pool: run command I used earlier: `gcloud compute instances create --count=8 --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g` — will tag them for auto-teardown.
Sam: quick ask — if Dedicated canary slips, can we still ship the API changes behind a feature flag so product work isn't blocked?
Jordan: yes, we merged FFs last week. We can gate the Dedicated routing with `feature.dedicated_routing` and toggle later.
Maya: ownership clarifications: Leah remains primary for Dedicated rollout, Jordan for runtime changes, Owen for SRE/infra, Sam for product validation. I'll update the doc.
Leah: dependency list for the doc: FIN-129 (quota), AZ-provision (infra change request), PR reviews (#451,#458). Adding timelines now.
Owen: FYI deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by Jordan at 1745090000.
deploy-bot: noted — scheduled deploy 1745090000 for runtime-v3-autoscale. Watch channels: #eng-releases, #incidents.
Sam: reviewers — @maria @chen can you prioritize the embed-api reviews? small changes, mostly test fixes.
Maya: next steps: 1) Jordan posts deploy note + rollback; 2) Owen provision temp pool; 3) Leah updates canary checklist and timeline; 4) Sam gathers product test cases behind feature flag. I'll paste the consolidated status in the sync doc by EOD.
Jordan: will do deploy note tonight.
Leah: will update checklist and ETA by EOD. :thumbsup:
Owen: provisioning started. will update when ready.
Sam: I'll ping reviewers in 30m.
Maya: perfect — if any critical blockers surface, add them here and mention me. Thanks everyone.
